verdict.rationale: Exa ships a ready-made `webSearch()` tool for OpenAI and Anthropic tool-calling loops, with recommended agentic defaults. It also offers a hosted, open-source MCP server that works in any MCP client with no API key needed to start, an official OpenAI plugin bundling the MCP server and skills, installable agent skills, and downloadable OpenAPI specs. Missing for 10: explicit published function-calling JSON schema definitions, documented integrations with named agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex), and independent hands-on corroboration of the tool-call integrations.
